WITH date_range AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS date) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS date)
),
ssr AS (
    SELECT s_store_id,
           SUM(sales) AS sales,
           SUM(returns) AS returns,
           SUM(profit) AS profit,
           SUM(profit_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
               SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
               SUM(ss_net_profit) AS profit,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS returns,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit_loss
        FROM store_sales
        WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_range)
        GROUP BY ss_store_sk
        UNION ALL
        SELECT sr_store_sk AS store_sk,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
               SUM(sr_return_amt) AS returns,
               SUM(sr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
        FROM store_returns
        WHERE sr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_range)
        GROUP BY sr_store_sk
    ) AS store_facts
    JOIN store ON store_facts.store_sk = store.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY s_store_id
),
csr AS (
    SELECT cp_catalog_page_id,
           SUM(sales) AS sales,
           SUM(returns) AS returns,
           SUM(profit) AS profit,
           SUM(profit_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT cs_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
               SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
               SUM(cs_net_profit) AS profit,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS returns,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit_loss
        FROM catalog_sales
        WHERE cs_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_range)
        GROUP BY cs_catalog_page_sk
        UNION ALL
        SELECT cr_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
               SUM(cr_return_amount) AS returns,
               SUM(cr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
        FROM catalog_returns
        WHERE cr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_range)
        GROUP BY cr_catalog_page_sk
    ) AS catalog_facts
    JOIN catalog_page ON catalog_facts.page_sk = catalog_page.cp_catalog_page_sk
    GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr AS (
    SELECT web_site_id,
           SUM(sales) AS sales,
           SUM(returns) AS returns,
           SUM(profit) AS profit,
           SUM(profit_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT ws_web_site_sk AS web_site_sk,
               SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
               SUM(ws_net_profit) AS profit,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS returns,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit_loss
        FROM web_sales
        WHERE ws_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_range)
        GROUP BY ws_web_site_sk
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ws_web_site_sk AS web_site_sk,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
               SUM(wr_return_amt) AS returns,
               SUM(wr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
        FROM (
            SELECT wr_item_sk, wr_order_number, wr_return_amt, wr_net_loss
            FROM web_returns
            WHERE wr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_range)
        ) AS wr
        INNER JOIN web_sales ON (wr.wr_item_sk = ws_item_sk AND wr.wr_order_number = ws_order_number)
        GROUP BY ws_web_site_sk
    ) AS web_facts
    JOIN web_site ON web_facts.web_site_sk = web_site.web_site_sk
    GROUP BY web_site_id
)
SELECT channel,
       id,
       SUM(sales) AS sales,
       SUM(returns) AS returns,
       SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
           'store' || s_store_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM ssr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
           'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM csr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
           'web_site' || web_site_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM wsr
) AS x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100
